note: Prompts and ground paths for Kimodo (kimodo_batch.py). legs: see paths.py. Never put Epic GASP data in here (README.md).
description: Clips beyond GASP's set: pushing and dragging, a car (entering, driving seated, leaving) and parkour moves. Text plus loose ground paths; Kimodo does not see the objects.

clips.name: Interact/Push_Heavy
clips.prompt: A person pushes a heavy object forward with both hands, leaning their weight into it and taking slow, strong steps.

clips.name: Interact/Push_Heavy_Start
clips.prompt: A person braces both hands against a heavy object, strains to get it moving and starts pushing it forward slowly.

clips.name: Interact/Drag_OneHand
clips.prompt: A person walks forward dragging a heavy object behind them with their right hand, leaning forward.

clips.name: Interact/Drag_OneHand_Back
clips.prompt: A person walks backwards pulling a heavy object toward them with their right hand.

clips.name: Car/Car_Enter
clips.prompt: A person opens a car door, ducks their head, gets into the driver's seat and sits down.

clips.name: Car/Car_Drive
clips.prompt: A person sits in a car seat driving, with both hands on the steering wheel, turning the wheel left and then right.

clips.name: Car/Car_Exit
clips.prompt: A person sitting in the driver's seat of a car swings their legs out, gets out of the car and stands up.

clips.name: Parkour/Speed_Vault
clips.prompt: A person runs forward, vaults over a waist-high obstacle with one hand on it, and keeps running.

clips.name: Parkour/Kong_Vault
clips.prompt: A person runs forward and dives over a box, pushing off it with both hands, then lands and keeps running.

clips.name: Parkour/Lazy_Vault
clips.prompt: A person runs forward and swings their legs sideways over a low wall with one hand on it, then keeps running.

clips.name: Parkour/Wall_Run_Up
clips.prompt: A person runs at a high wall, runs two steps up it, grabs the top with both hands and climbs up onto it.

clips.name: Parkour/Wall_Run_Side
clips.prompt: A person runs along a wall on their left side, taking several steps on the wall, then drops back to the ground and keeps running.

clips.name: Parkour/Roll
clips.prompt: A person jumps down from a ledge, lands and does a forward shoulder roll, then gets up and keeps running.

clips.name: Parkour/Climb_Up
clips.prompt: A person jumps up, grabs the top of a high wall with both hands and pulls themselves up onto it.

clips.name: Parkour/Precision_Jump
clips.prompt: A person jumps forward from both feet over a gap and lands precisely with both feet together, holding their balance.

clips.name: Parkour/Cat_Leap
clips.prompt: A person runs and leaps at a wall, catching its top edge with both hands with their feet against the wall, then climbs up.

clips.name: Parkour/Tic_Tac
clips.prompt: A person runs toward a wall, kicks off it with one foot to jump to the side and keeps running.

clips.name: Parkour/Wall_Flip
clips.prompt: A person runs at a wall, runs two steps up it and does a backflip off it, landing on their feet.

clips.name: Parkour/Front_Flip
clips.prompt: A person runs forward, does a front flip, lands on their feet and keeps running.
